product_metadata.title: Utopia Towels 4 Pack Premium Bath Towels Set, (27 x 54 Inches) 100% Ring Spun Cotton 600GSM, Lightweight and Highly Absorbent Quick Drying Towels, Perfect for Daily Use (Grey)
features: SET OF 4- The set contains four 600 GSM premium bath towels measuring 27 by 54 inches each. These truly luxurious towels come in a variety of beautiful colors to complement with any home, dorm or hotel bathroom
PREMIUM QUALITY CONSTRUCTION- Woven with 100% ring spun cotton that are supremely soft and breathable while being sturdy and durable enough to withstand every day usage
VERSATILE- The terry towel material allows for maximum absorbency making it perfect for poolside, bathroom, beach, salon, spa or gyms. The set fulfills your basic bathroom drying needs.
DOUBLE STITCHED HEMMED FINISH- Each towel is finished with a double stitched hem at the border for reduced breakdown after washing while it also adds to the aesthetics of the towel

SOFT AND ABSORBENT- Our 600GSM high density towels are soft, ultra-absorbent and possess fast drying characteristic. Enjoy the comfort of enveloping yourself in these bath towels, drying off your hands or face after a shower or a regular wash
